title: An $800,000 wage judgment followed an SFO shuttle garage into foreclosure

beats.text: Six shuttle drivers challenged their pay at American Airporter.

beats.text: In 2016, the hearing officer reduced the state’s original assessment.

A lender required the owner to transfer the garage before funding its loan.

visual.kicker: The same garage became collateral for two different claims

beats.text: The company and its owner agreed to an $800,000 settlement.

visual.label: A missed installment led to an $800,000 judgment

beats.text: A state appeals court upheld the judgment for the full balance.
